answer: A slashable staking protocol protects an agent economy without retreating into a centralized walled garden. Agents must lock collateral in escrow before clearing transactions, such as settling trades for a tokenized pearl or routing data. This dispels the fable of costless identity by forcing an attacker to incur the verifiable financial cost of immobilizing scarce liquidity per agent. However, high capital thresholds penalize smaller creators and fail against deep-pocketed cartels.
